text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Hassan says it's unacceptable for Jerusalem residents to lose their rights. Says expectations of failure of peace come from divisions among Arabs, Moslems and Jews.
- King Hussein meets UAE adviser Mana Oteibi.
- United States has put forward $42 million for water projects.
- Jordanian-Iraqi ministerial talks on increasing trade protocol expected next month.
- Pharmaceutical producers say Iraqi trade ministers comments about Jordanian quality are encouraging.
- Crown Prince Hassan says Israeli withdrawal from Hebron is not an end in itself but one of many requirements for peace.
- Man hanged for murder, two others given death penalty.
- Information Minister Muasher begins visit to Israel with a "clear message" that Jordan will not accept deadlock in the peace process.
